hub.title: Reports
hub.profitCaption: Revenue less cost of goods and expenses
hub.subtitle: Financial year to date · {{currency}}

home.welcomeBody: {{company}} is ready. Raise your first invoice and this page fills in with your sales, collections and what you are owed.

customer.title: Add a customer
customer.body: Who you sell to, with their GSTIN and address for the invoice.

item.title: Add a product or service
item.body: What you sell, with its price and GST rate, so lines fill in for you.

invoice.title: Create your first invoice
invoice.body: Bill a customer and send it as a PDF, link or WhatsApp.

home.noInvoicesBody: Create your first invoice and it will show up here.

shell.basisFull: {{company}} · {{from}} to {{to}} · {{branch}} · presented in {{currency}}, foreign-currency documents converted at the rate stored on each document.

detail.noTdsBody: With a TAN in company settings and a TDS section on a supplier, TDS is worked out on their bills.
detail.noAdvancesBody: Every payment in this period is fully set against invoices or bills.
detail.unknownBody: Pick a report from the Reports tab.
detail.noTaxableSales: No taxable sales in this period.
detail.noTaxablePurchases: No taxable purchases in this period.

msme.owed: Owed to micro and small suppliers
msme.interestBasis: Interest the law adds once late: {{rate}} a year (three times the bank rate), compounded monthly. For information.
msme.notInTime: Not paid in time this year
msme.notInTimeBasis: For your CA: what wasn’t paid within the limit can’t be deducted this year (Income-tax Act s.43B(h)); it is deducted in the year it is paid.
msme.none: Nothing due to micro or small suppliers
msme.noneBody: Mark a supplier as a micro or small enterprise, with their Udyam number, to track their bills here.

salesSummary.title: Sales summary
salesSummary.description: By month, customer, item and branch

purchaseSummary.title: Purchase summary
purchaseSummary.description: What you bought and from whom

receivables.title: Receivables
receivables.description: Who owes you, and for how long
receivables.basis: Outstanding = document total less allocated payments.

payables.title: Payables
payables.basis: Outstanding = bill total less payments made.

stock.title: Stock report
stock.basis: Quantity derived from every stock movement; value at weighted average cost.

taxSummary.title: Tax summary
taxSummary.description: Output vs input tax, ready to file
taxSummary.basis: Output tax on sales less input tax on purchases.

payments.title: Payments & cash
payments.description: Money in and out by method

advances.title: Advances
advances.description: Advance receipts and payments still to adjust
advances.basis: Payments dated in the period with money not yet set against an invoice or bill

profit.title: Profit snapshot
profit.basis: Revenue is taxable value, so tax collected is not counted as income.

tdsRegister.title: TDS deducted
tdsRegister.description: TDS kept back on supplier bills, by section and quarter
tdsRegister.basis: Supplier bills and notes dated in the period, by deductee: the figures for Form 26Q

msmePayables.title: MSME payments due
msmePayables.description: Micro and small suppliers’ bills against the 45-day limit
msmePayables.basis: Unpaid on the period’s last day. Due on the agreed day, never more than 45 days after the bill, or in 15 days if nothing was agreed (MSMED Act s.15).

caption.advancesReceived: From customers, to adjust against invoices
caption.advancesPaid: To suppliers, to adjust against bills
